title: Generic Error with name 'JsonRpcMethodNotFoundError' misclassified as -32601 Method Not Found instead of -32603 Internal Error
evidence: Verified on candidate f3fff38a84154a36f017514c234421aef5215ced (sha256 24e9a99fb89f6383390c19998d3df1e50b0fb05a244b7d627e08f260105e1514). Handler throwing `const err = new Error('backend fault'); err.name = 'JsonRpcMethodNotFoundError'; throw err;` now correctly returns error.code -32603 (Internal Error). Genuine typed JsonRpcMethodNotFoundError and its subclasses continue to return error.code -32601.
